items.title: Dave Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Wilton, Connecticut, November 21, 2001
items.q: And it came on every night out of Washington with Willis Conover.

ctx.x: Yeah. Trying to change the course of what some of his other people wanted.

Yeah. And so was Martin Luther King. And so was Christ. And it’s gotta come from the grassroots up. And when I was in these countries I used to be appalled by the lies constantly going on the air about the United States. And right today it’s going on. There are so many great things they could say about us and show what we’re trying to do in Afghanistan, but they don’t show that. They show always the death of some children, which is terrible, and they show always the negative. We should have been investing so much…

Very interesting. I hadn’t heard a lot of that. Regarding your choral work, if you could pick a section of a particular piece that you felt really came together as far as the way the text was set and the orchestration and the whole thing that resounded the best for you, is there a moment, a favorite of yours?
